estimate.note: V2 formula — execution-only, did not include context retransmission (cache hit). Estimated only cache miss + output.

actual_api_calls.note: 用户手动从 platform.deepseek.com dashboard 读取

accuracy.assessment: Catastrophic underestimate. Formula lacked context retransmission layer.
accuracy.root_cause: 每次 API 调用重传完整上下文（系统提示+CLAUDE.md+工具定义+对话历史）产生大量缓存命中 tokens，占总消耗的 97.7%。旧公式仅估算了执行层（cache miss + output = 2.3%）的部分。
accuracy.fix_applied: V4 formula adds Layer 2 (context retransmission) and 3-tier cost calculation. Panel now shows cache hit / cache miss / output separately.

key_metrics.note: If only counting execution tokens (miss+output=256K), the estimate of 52K was off by ~5x. The 217x gap is entirely due to missing the cache hit layer.

per_call_analysis.insight: Average context per API call is 119K, 2.5x higher than V5 assumed 48K. CLAUDE.md (115 lines) + system prompt + tool definitions + conversation history accumulates to much larger context than estimated. This is the primary remaining source of Layer 2 underestimation.

v4_backtest.layer1_output: 108K estimated vs 37K actual (2.9x over — actual had less generation than typical)
v4_backtest.layer2_root_cause: API call count estimated 40 (conversation mode) but actual was 93 calls in agent mode (confirmed via dashboard). With actual 93 calls and 119K avg context per call: 93 × 119K = 11.07M cache hit. V5 agent multiplier 3.5x on base 40 → 140 calls is an overcorrection, the real gap is per-call context size (119K actual vs 48K assumed = 2.5x).
v4_backtest.small_project_issue: 9.4x overestimate for skill_plugin V1 (396K vs 42K). Call count estimated 15 (conversation mode) but actual was likely 3-5 calls even in agent mode for such a small spec-driven project. The base [5,20] call range combined with agent multiplier 3.5x gives 17-70 calls, still too high.
v4_backtest.key_insight: Both call count AND per-call context size need adjustment. For large projects, conversation history accumulation drives per-call context 2-3x above initial assumptions.
